title: AlphaFold3 Input
description: Input schema for AlphaFold 3 structure prediction via Isomorphic Labs API. Supports multi-chain protein complexes, DNA/RNA, and small-molecule ligands. Chain IDs with a 'dna:' or 'rna:' prefix are treated as nucleic acids.

chains.description: List of polymer chains. IDs prefixed with 'dna:' or 'rna:' are treated as nucleic-acid chains; otherwise protein.

id.description: Chain identifier. Prefix with 'dna:' or 'rna:' for nucleic acids.

sequence.description: One-letter sequence (protein: ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY; DNA: ACGT; RNA: ACGU).

ligands.description: Optional list of small-molecule ligands attached to the complex.

id.description: Ligand identifier used in the output CIF.

ccd_or_smiles.description: Either a PDB CCD three-letter code (e.g. 'ATP') or a SMILES string.

seeds.description: Explicit integer seeds. Length should equal params.num_seeds.
